 -2-  HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE P.NAVEEN RAO  AND  HON'BLE SMT Dr.JUSTICE G.RADHA RANI  WRIT PETITION No.32036 of 2021 ORDER:

(per Hon'ble Sri Justice P.Naveen Rao) This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief :
"...to issue an appropriate Writ or Order or Direction, more specifically in the nature of Writ of Habeas Corpus, directing the respondents herein to produce the detenu by name Mr. Shaik Ismail S/o.Shaik Ameen Satar, Aged about 31 yrs, Occu : Bike Sri. Thrimurthula Kumar vs The State Of Telangana And 2 Others on 17 February, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116224486/
1 Mechanic, R/o.H.No.3- 102, Annavaram, Near Rama Temple, Chodavaram Mandalam, Annavaram, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh State, before this Hon'ble Court and set him at liberty by declaring the detention order daed 29.06.2021 issued in proceedings No.68/PD- CELL/CCRB/RCKD/2021 dated 29.06.2021 passed by the 2nd respondent herein and the consequential order issued by the 1st respondent i.e., G.O.Rt.No.2085,
General Administration (Spl) (Law & Order) Department, dated 13.09.2021 as illegal,
arbitrary and violative of the detenu's fundamental rights guaranteed...."
2.

This writ petition is instituted by the brother-in-law of detenu Shaik Ismail, challenging the order of detention dated 29.06.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders,
Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders,
Cyber Crime offenders and While Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 13 of 2018).
3. Heard Sri Apurva M.Gokhale, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for home.
4.

sentences.text: The order of detention was passed by taking note of involvement of detenu in Cr.No.1104 of 2020 under Section 8 (c) r/w.20 (b) (ii) (B) of Narcotic Drugs And Psychotropic Substances, Act, 1985 in Uppal Police Station, Rachakonda.

entities.text: Narcotic Drugs And Psychotropic Substances, Act, 1985
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The detenu is shown as Accused No.1 in the said crime.
Against Accused Nos.3 and 4 in the same crime, preventive detention orders were also passed on 30.04.2021.
Challenging the said orders of detention W.P.Nos.14649 and 19930 of 2021 are filed.

This Court by order dated 02.11.2021 and 09.11.2021 allowed the said writ petitions setting aside the orders of detention on the ground that while considering involvement of detenus in the crime and granting of bail, the detaining authority did not consider the conditions imposed in the bail granted to them.
5. The Court is informed that the same principle also applies to the case on hand.

6. In view thereof and following the decision in W.P.Nos.14649 and 19930 of 2021, and for the reasons assigned therein, this writ petition is also allowed setting aside the impugned detention order dated 29.06.2021.

The respondents are directed to set the detenu namely Shaik Ismail S/o.Shaik Ameen Satar, Aged 31 yrs, Occu : Bike Mechanic, R/o.H.No.3-102, Annavaram, Near Rama Temple, Chodavaram Mandalam, Annavaram, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh at liberty forthwith, if he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.

__________________ P.NAVEEN RAO,J ______________________ Dr. G.RADHA RANI,J 17th February, 2022 Rds Sri. Thrimurthula Kumar vs The State Of Telangana And 2 Others on 17 February, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116224486/
